say: Seventeen days, fifty-two builds. Here's how the LPN Pallet Log grew.
Build thirteen, the earliest one saved: every pallet logged by type, with running totals.
Build nineteen added trailer and seal numbers, and live tracking against the manifest.
Build twenty-three: undo the last pallet in one tap.
By build thirty-four, the manifest check reads photos and PDFs of the manifest, and shows what's missing and what's extra.
Build forty-four: a report button, so problems get flagged straight from the dock.
Build forty-nine: damaged pallets, marked crushed, wet, or in your own words.
Version four, build fifty-two: ready to share, with a welcome card and a demo video.
Then pallets with no LPN, and descriptions for FPP pallets.
Build sixty-two: refused pallets, sent back with the driver.
And build sixty-five: scan by photo, upload photos, and read the printed LPN when a barcode won't scan.
